title: G20: add the external integrations launch register
public_pr_body:

A per-service verification record includes requirement/expected/actual/evidence/tester/date/approval; actual state remains NOT EXECUTED/NOT VERIFIED and approvals stay blank.

Reuses #375's security review; adds the missing operational register rather than claiming deployment settings have been checked. Proposed automatic services OFF is an approval proposal, not an observation; manual email/export decisions remain explicit. Calls out uncertain send/retry duplicates, the unresolved AI cap finding and source references. No service was called, connected or enabled.

G20: register ready; actual launch state/owners/approvals pending. Separate branch from main 68f89ca, docs only. Source/required-field and git diff --check review only; no runtime result claimed. No production SQL/data, merge, #359/candidate edits, Ready label or message to John.
